q: Von Neumann entropy S(ρ) = -Tr[ρ log ρ] for a quantum state ρ equals Shannon entropy H when:
opts: ρ is diagonal in some basis (the eigenvalues form a classical probability distribution)
exp: When ρ = ∑λᵢ|i⟩⟨i| is diagonal, S(ρ) = -∑λᵢ log λᵢ = H(λ₁,…,λd). Von Neumann entropy generalises Shannon entropy to quantum states, with the eigenvalues of ρ playing the role of the probability distribution.
